name: OneCatalog
waMessage: Hi OneCatalog, I want a catalogue for my business.
entity: OneCatalog makes online product catalogues for Indian small businesses. You send your products with photos and prices on WhatsApp, and we build your catalogue with one shareable link. Send that link on WhatsApp instead of forwarding dozens of photos. Customers see your full catalogue on their phone, and they can message you to order. It costs ₹3,999 for the first year for up to 50 products.
trust: ₹999 to start, refunded if not approved
Anywhere in India, all on WhatsApp

author.name: Vinod Kumar
author.bio: Vinod has 16 years of experience in operations and supply chain. He and his team build every OneCatalog catalogue from the photos and price lists that shop owners send on WhatsApp.

tiers.label: Lite
tiers.domainNote: Link on onecatalog.in, no own domain

includes: Up to 50 products, each with its own page
A WhatsApp enquiry button on every product
Your own domain name, registered in your business name
12 update requests a year, up to 10 products each
Photo clean-up: square crop and brightness fix
Setup of your WhatsApp Business profile, greeting message and quick replies on a 15-minute video or WhatsApp call
Your catalogue link added to your Google Business Profile
pricing.riskReversal: Pay ₹999 to start. Pay the balance only after you see your catalogue live and approve it. If you do not approve it, the ₹999 is fully refunded.
pricing.tableNote: The price depends only on how many products you have. Nothing else.
pricing.everyPlan: Every plan includes hosting, 12 update requests a year of up to 10 products each, and going live in 48 hours. Extra update batches cost ₹299 for 10 products.

footer.line: OneCatalog makes online product catalogues for small businesses across India.
